stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: White House announces Trump will visit China March 31-April 2. First face-to-face with Xi this term. Tariffs, AI competition, gallium export controls, and Taiwan all on agenda. Visit creates hard deadline for trade standoff resolution.

stories.label: US to reopen embassy in Syria after 14 years
stories.summary: US State Department notified Congress of intent to reopen Damascus embassy, closed since 2012. Phased approach. Signals acceptance of post-Assad transition and desire to shape Syria's reconstruction.

stories.label: Thailand election may be voided over barcode blunder
stories.summary: Two weeks after Thailand's election to break political stalemate, annulment threat hangs over entire vote due to barcode printing error in ballots. Court ruling expected soon.

stories.label: Package bomb at Argentina gendarmerie school in Buenos Aires
stories.summary: Explosive device detonated at National Gendarmerie Superior School in central Buenos Aires, injuring four personnel. Comes amid deep political tensions under Milei — strikes, labor reform backlash.

stories.label: Blood test predicts Alzheimer's symptom onset
stories.summary: Researchers developed a blood test that can predict when Alzheimer's symptoms will begin. Potential paradigm shift in diagnosis — could enable early intervention before cognitive decline.

stories.label: DeepMind spinoff unveils 'AlphaFold 4' for drug discovery
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs (DeepMind's drug discovery arm) released new AI model scientists are calling 'AlphaFold 4.' Goes beyond protein structure prediction into full molecular interaction modeling. Major step toward AI-driven pharmaceutical development.

stories.label: Grok AI exposes user's protected identity without being asked
stories.summary: Elon Musk's AI chatbot Grok exposed a performer's protected legal name and birthdate to the public without any prompt. Latest in a string of Grok privacy violations. Combined with OpenAI school shooter case, AI data handling obligations under scrutiny.

stories.label: US Supreme Court strikes down tariffs; Section 122 hits all countries including deal partners
stories.summary: Supreme Court struck down emergency tariffs 6-3. Trump invoked Section 122 for 10% global tariff effective Feb 24. Hits ALL countries including deal partners. Democrats demanding refunds. Constitutional confrontation deepening. Now superseded by Trump-China summit announcement.

stories.label: Iran-US nuclear standoff, military buildup, and domestic unrest
stories.summary: ~6 days remain on Trump's ultimatum. Iran says counterproposal coming soon. 40-day memorial protests add domestic pressure. Military buildup continues. UK blocked bases. Dual-track crisis: external standoff plus internal unrest.

stories.label: US ambassador endorses Israeli expansion across Middle East
stories.summary: US ambassador Mike Huckabee told Tucker Carlson it would be 'fine' if Israel expanded from Nile to Euphrates. Unprecedented statement from a sitting US ambassador.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire fraying — strikes widen
stories.summary: Israeli strikes widening across Lebanon — 10+ killed in Bekaa Valley today on top of yesterday's 8+. Ceasefire eroding daily. Hezbollah rejected disarmament.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal stalls over farming safeguards
stories.summary: Europe legislating automatic safeguard mechanisms for agriculture while Argentina pushes to finalise the deal.

stories.label: Record 37-day rainfall devastates western France
stories.summary: 37 consecutive days of rain have caused disastrous flooding in western France. Climate-linked extreme precipitation.

stories.label: North Korea party congress — succession and military doctrine
stories.summary: Kim Ju-ae conspicuously absent from rare party congress. Succession questions. Congress formalising military doctrine.

stories.label: GGML/llama.cpp creator joins Hugging Face
stories.summary: Georgi Gerganov's GGML joining Hugging Face. Consolidates open-source AI ecosystem.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecating Archive.today and removing links after evidence of DDoS attacks and altered web captures.

stories.label: Saudi-UAE rift over Sudan RSF and Yemen STC
stories.summary: MBS sent detailed complaint to UAE over Emirati support for Sudan's RSF and Yemen's STC. Letter shared with Washington.

stories.label: Trump pursues Saudi nuclear deal with enrichment path
stories.summary: US negotiating nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia that would allow enrichment — while demanding Iran end enrichment.

stories.label: Hungary blocks €90B EU loan to Ukraine over Russian oil
stories.summary: Hungary threatening to veto €90B EU loan to Ukraine after Kyiv halted Russian oil transit.

stories.label: NASA targets March for Artemis II crewed Moon mission
stories.summary: NASA targeting early March for Artemis II — first crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972.

stories.label: FT exposes $90B Russian oil sanctions evasion network
stories.summary: FT investigation reveals shell company network exporting $90B in sanctioned Russian oil.

stories.label: Mass killings in northwestern Nigeria
stories.summary: 50+ killed and women/children abducted in Zamfara. NW Nigeria security crisis worsening.

stories.label: China routing drones to Russia via Thailand
stories.summary: China using Thailand as transit point to ship drones to Russia, circumventing sanctions.

stories.label: Sudan genocide and humanitarian crisis — aid workers now targeted
stories.summary: RSF drone attack killed 3 aid workers in Kordofan. UN crossed genocide threshold. Saudi-UAE rift over RSF complicates response.

stories.label: US removes Vietnam from tech export control list
stories.summary: Trump told Vietnam's To Lam he will remove the country from restricted tech export lists. Geopolitical realignment in SE Asian tech supply chains.

stories.label: OpenAI flagged school shooter but did not alert police
stories.summary: OpenAI's abuse detection flagged shooter's account months before Canadian school shooting but chose not to alert police. Sets precedent for AI company reporting obligations.

stories.label: China's Yangtze fishing ban shows major ecological recovery
stories.summary: Midpoint assessment of China's 10-year Yangtze fishing ban shows fish biomass surging and finless porpoise rebounding.

stories.label: Americans dismantling Flock surveillance cameras
stories.summary: Grassroots movement physically dismantling Flock Safety's ALPR cameras across the US. Resistance moved from legal challenges to direct action.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: Broad AI race theme now splitting into more specific arcs (AlphaFold 4, Grok privacy, OpenAI safety). Keeping as context.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Talks stalled. No new round announced. Focus shifted to Iran crisis.

stories.label: Hamas holds vote for new interim leader
stories.summary: Hamas conducting internal vote for new interim leader. Announcement expected during Ramadan.

stories.label: China's gallium grip ahead of Trump Beijing visit
stories.summary: China controls ~80% of global gallium/germanium supply. Export control deadline looming. Context for upcoming Trump-China summit.

stories.label: Personalized mRNA cancer vaccine shows durable immunity
stories.summary: Nature paper: personalized mRNA vaccines produce durable T cell immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.
